supportedClaims: Sign Constraint Origin: phi originates from KTC via sign(dT/dp), threshold form universal (SCO_01, P12)
Zero-Set Geometry: phi^{-1}(0) is automatically a geometric object, no external axioms (ZGS_01, P13)
Intrinsic Geometry: boundary geometry survives removal of ambient coordinates (IGS_01, P14)
Intrinsic Metric: intrinsic arc lengths and geodesic distances defined on boundary alone (IMS_01)
Intrinsic Curvature Generation: curvature is structural property of boundary geometry (ICG_01)
Curvature Threshold: intrinsic curvature becomes possible at bdim >= 2 (ICS_02, P16)
Local Geometry: local geometric quantities recoverable intrinsically (LGS_01)
Intrinsic Dimension: dimension recoverable from metric growth alone (IDE_01, P15)
Local Homogeneity: geometry is locally homogeneous (LHI_01, P17)
Symmetry Emergence: symmetry emerges from homogeneous geometry (SGS_01, P18)
Geometry is primary; memory is a derived observable: Boundary -> Geometry -> Projection -> Memory
hypotheses: Boundary dynamics: can intrinsic geometry support propagation, flow, or dynamics? (V21)
Wave equation on intrinsic boundary: does the intrinsic metric support a natural Laplacian?
Time-like parameter: can a time-like ordering emerge from boundary dynamics?
2D boundary dynamics: do bdim=2 surfaces support richer dynamics than 1D?
